source_title: Sainik School Nagrota Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 TGT, Art Master and More Posts - FreeJobAlert.Com
source_excerpt:
Sainik School Nagrota, Jammu and Kashmir, has invited applications for 3 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. EN 31/61. The posts include TGT (Computer Science), Art Master, Nursing Sister (Female). Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.
The posts are for Nagrota, Jammu. Qualification required: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Application, B.Ed, Master's degree in Fine Arts, B.Sc. (Nursing) / Nursing Diploma. The pay is Rs. 25,500 to Rs. 1,42,400, depending on the post. Post-wise eligibility, dates and the steps to apply are given below.
How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says
Pay: Rs. 25,500 to Rs. 1,42,400, depending on the post
Fee: No application fee is mentioned in the notification
Age limit: Varies by post - see the table below
Sainik School Nagrota Recruitment 2026 - Overview
The official notification does not specify the application fee.
Sainik School Nagrota Notification PDF 2026
Advt No. EN 31/61 gives the full conditions for each post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below.
Download Sainik School Nagrota notification PDF
Age is counted on last date of receipt of application.
Who Can Apply for Sainik School Nagrota Recruitment 2026?
Having PG Degree or any other higher qualification
Additional qualification in Computer Course in Networking/ IT/AI & Machine Learning
Experience of teaching in English medium residential school
Proficiency in Games/ Sports /other outdoor activities
Talents in Music/public speaking/fine arts etc.
Who Cannot Apply for Sainik School Nagrota Recruitment 2026
Applications received after last date will be rejected
Qualification required: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Application (BCA) with at least 50% marks OR Graduation in Computer Science/IT with at least 50% marks; Qualified in the Central Teachers Eligibility Test-II (CTET-II) or State Teacher Eligibility Test (STET); Bachelor's degree in Education from NCTE recognized institution OR Three years integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. OR Four years integrated degree with at least 50% marks. Age limit: 21 to 35 years. Pay: Pay Matrix Level-7 (Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 ).
Qualification required: Master's degree in Fine Arts (with Painting specialization) OR Graduate with Fine Arts/Art/ Drawing and Painting with minimum 04 years diploma OR Higher Secondary/ Intermediate/Sr. Sec. School Certificate with minimum 5 years (full time)/ 7 years (part time) diploma in Fine Art. Age limit: 21 to 35 years. Pay: Consolidated Salary: Rs. 35,000 Per month.
Qualification required: B.Sc. (Nursing) / Nursing Diploma from a recognized institute + Registration with Indian / State Nursing Council + Minimum 02 years experience. Experience required: Minimum 02 years experience of working in hospital / clinic. Age limit: 18 to 50 years. Pay: Consolidated Salary: Rs. 25,500 Per month.
Initial period of one year (11 serving months plus 01 month break period), extendable annually up to a maximum period of three years
How to Apply for Sainik School Nagrota Recruitment 2026 Offline
Applications from eligible and suitable candidates should be sent as per details given against each.
Last date for receiving of applications is within 21 days from the date of publication of this advertisement in Employment News.
Make sure it reaches by 20 November 2026.
Contractual staff shall have no claim or right to regular appointment
